entries.title: Mindfulness programs
entries.content: Studies of mindfulness-based stress reduction (MBSR) have found people report less stress and anxiety. It is a learnable practice, not a replacement for care.
entries.source: Systematic Review for Medical Applications of Meditation - PMC
entries.label: Evidence summary - education only

entries.title: Meditation and the body
entries.content: Some studies link regular meditation with lower blood pressure and stress markers. Results vary, and it works best alongside medical advice.
entries.source: Meditation and Its Mental and Physical Health Benefits in 2023 - PMC
entries.label: Evidence summary - education only

entries.title: Yoga
entries.content: Research suggests yoga can help with flexibility, balance, sleep quality and some kinds of back discomfort. Start gently and check with a professional if you have pain or a condition.
entries.label: Evidence summary - education only
